Hedionda quadrangles. The maps and associated reports can be 
downloaded at the NM Bureau of Geology website at the following 
links:

Ojo Hedionda quad) 
http://geoinfo.nmt.eduipublicationsimaps/geologic/oftunidetails.cfml?Volume=143 ( 
Stanley quad) 
Ranch headquarters is in the northeast part of the Stanley map. The Galisteo basin 
north of headquarters is on the Ojo Hedionda map.
